section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the participants and procedure for a single study conducted online via Amazon's Mechanical Turk in January 2016. The final sample consisted of 199 women and 200 men (N=399) from the United States, with a mean age of 34.55 years and mean BMI of 26.62 kg/m². The majority of participants (81.7%) self-identified as White, and 66.3% had completed college or higher education. Data were collected online via Qualtrics survey platform, with measures presented in random order.
